Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help you today?

Hi Rachel Tan, Marcus Lim here. Finally got a quiet gap between work calls. Today quite packed, but I wanted to have that brief discussion over the phone.

Certainly. May I take your identification details before we begin?

Got the details here already. My NRIC is S three four six seven eight seven seven G. My date of birth is the thirteenth of May nineteen ninety-five.

Thank you. Is speaking by telephone generally more convenient for you than arranging a meeting?

Telephone easier lah. With the logistics business, my schedule keeps moving around. Sometimes got a quiet office, sometimes I'm out visiting the warehouse. Meetings quite difficult to pin down.

We can keep today's discussion focused. Please tell me what you have in mind.

Got my note here already. The bond I want to transact in is Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031. I want to buy, not sell.

Your objective is to build contractual interest income while holding the bond toward maturity; that is the investment goal I am working to. With Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, deterioration in the issuer's creditworthiness could reduce the bond's market price. If the issuer defaults, it could stop paying interest or fail to repay the principal. Do you understand how weaker issuer credit could affect this bond's price, and how default could affect the payments you receive?

Yes, I understand. If the issuer's credit gets worse, the price can drop; if they default, interest and principal payments may not come through.

You could lose part or even all of the capital you invest in this bond. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this purchase, including substantial losses if the issuer defaults?

Yes, I'm willing to accept those investment losses, including substantial losses if the issuer defaults. The entry price still matters to me lah. Still got time to finish the discussion.

For executing this transaction, we will charge you 0.25%. I recommend this bond because its scheduled interest payments support your income objective, and holding toward maturity reduces your reliance on an attractive early resale opportunity. For the proposed purchase, the settlement currency would be American dollars.

Use that currency you just mentioned for my transaction lah. My transaction amount is 25,000 in that currency. Quantity-wise, I want 100 units. Make it a limit order at 250 American dollars. Don't pay above that, hor. Got something else to mention. The issuer's finance executive told me in confidence that a major improvement in their financial position will be announced publicly; it's not public yet. That's why I'm instructing you to make this purchase before the announcement.

Please confirm your final instruction: buy 100 units of Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031 using a limit order at 250 American dollars, for a transaction amount of 25,000 in American dollars. Is that the instruction you want me to execute?

Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you've just stated. Please go ahead. If you need to reach me later, message first hor. During work I don't always hear the phone one.

I will note your preference for a message before a telephone follow-up. Thank you for making time to speak today.

Can. Thanks for taking the call, Rachel Tan. Need to get back to the office now.

Thank you, Marcus Lim. Goodbye.
